# THE INSTALL CHECK'S pipx, LOCKED BY HASH (#563, decision 5).
#
# The install check in `.github/workflows/release.yml` installs exactly the
# files named here, with `--only-binary :all: --require-hashes`, on each of
# its four legs, then installs the openreposhape wheel with that pipx, as a
# person does. UNIVERSAL, for Linux, macOS and Windows: pipx 1.11.1 below
# Python 3.10, the newest pipx that installs on 3.9 (the package's oldest
# Python), and the newest pipx above it. pipx then installs pip into its own
# shared environment, which no lock here reaches; the job's `PIP_INDEX_URL`
# holds every pip it runs to PyPI.
#
# RESOLVED, NOT WRITTEN BY HAND, with uv 0.12.18, from PyPI as it stood at
# 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z. To change it, run the command below with a newer
# date, put this header back above the output, and commit the diff as its
# own act:
#
#     printf 'pipx\n' \
#       | uv pip compile --universal --python-version 3.9 --generate-hashes \
#           --no-header --index-url https://pypi.org/simple --only-binary :all: \
#           --exclude-newer <date> - -o .github/release-pipx-requirements.txt
